text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The head of the directorate of religious affairs urges people to steer clear of false religious leaders in a reference to growth of Islamic sects.
- Friday is fourth anniversary of car-bomb killing of journalist Ugur Mumcu. Families who lost members in mystery murders ask authorities to bring them to light.
- Former interior minister who resigned over a security scandal is accused of ordering the release of a drug smuggler.
- Hopes in economy strengthened as constitutional court approves the privatisation of Turk Telekom.
- No legal action so far to investigate why top policeman and fugitive murder suspect were drinking and dancing together.
- Famous Turkish writer Yasar Kemal wins Italy's Nonino prize.
- Kurdish guerrillas blow up Iraqi-Turkish oil pipeline.
- Interior minister denies that Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller's name was mentioned in a drug smuggler's trial in Germany.
